summary: User confirmed persisted Domain Events require explicit eventName while transient events may omit it. Generator must project the name into DomainEvent.value and Analyzer must detect metadata/runtime conflicts. Audit also established that BuildingBlock and AggregateElement are BINARY analyzer metadata carriers with no runtime consumer, but currently carry information that cannot be inferred losslessly.
nextAction: Choose whether to relocate the annotations to a dedicated compile-time metadata contract, replace them with a sidecar skeleton index, or retain them unchanged for now.
